title: Rust receiver replay gate: pure claim_seq high-water (drop (superframe,seq) tuple compare)
description: Child of l1qw.20 (receiver semantics leg). SlotClaimVerifier::verify (rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs:849-856) rejects only when (superframe_id, claim_sequence) tuple fails to advance. spec/08 step 8 + claim_seq persistence table mandate a PURE claim_seq high-water per gateway IID: reject iff claim_seq <= cached_seq, independent of superframe. Divergence: cached (N,5), current superframe N+1, validly-signed claim (N+1,4) is ACCEPTED by Rust but MUST be rejected (4 <= 5) — this defeats the anti-rollback design for rebooted/NVS-wiped senders (spec: re-init to 0 after wipe must be rejected by coordinators holding the old high-water). Fix: compare claim_sequence only; keep last_seen entries (iid, superframe, seq) and the sealed SlotReplaySnapshot format UNCHANGED so persisted state loads without migration. Keep StaleSuperframe exact-match gate upstream. Keep loser-reclaim (higher seq, same superframe) working. Align with test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json claim_seq_replay_equal/claim_seq_replay_lower. Note: capacity 256/no-LRU is nug9's scope, not this bead.
